title: Researchers At UC San Diego Are Learning About the Benefits of Human Milk and How It Influences Infant and Child Health
summary: The purpose of the UCSD Human Milk Biorepository is to establish and maintain a repository of breast milk samples that can be used to learn more about how breast milk influences infant and child health.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women who are 18 years old or older
* Breastfeeding
* Producing sufficient breast milk to donate an excess to the Biorepository

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women under 18 years old
